notes.title: Eternal Return Update 1.2
notes.content:
Here's another update! 
[list]
    [*]Fixed slippery controls and tightened player movement in general
    [*]Resolved inconsistency when jumping
    [*]Added a mechanic to improve starting special weapon points at each respawn.
    [*]Miscellaneous graphic fixes
[/list]

[i]Prior fixes:[/i]
[list]
    [*][i]Fixed unfair enemy ambushes when exiting buildings[/i]
    [*][i]Fixed missed damage feedback from certain enemies[/i]
    [*][i]Adjusted control sensitivity[/i]
    [*][i]Fixed graphical continuity issues in Refugee Encampment[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
Eternal Return goes live this Friday!

Thank you to everyone who has engaged with the project pre-release. Eternal Return has been a huge part of my life for the last two years, and I'm very happy to say I'll be delivering a game very much aligned with my original vision.

Some notes on the release:
   [list] [*]Eternal Return will be priced at USD 9.99 (with corresponding prices in other currencies.) 
    [*]We'll launch with a week long 15% discount, but there won't be another discount for at least six months. I've created something I'm very proud of, and think it's worth standing at a constant, fair price.
    [*]The game will launch on 24 February 2017 at 12:01 AM Pacific Time Zone if you want to do your own midnight release!
[/list]
